profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer @ Qure4u | Bachelor of Engineering
profile.summary:
Maria is a Senior Software Engineer with 12 years of experience. Maria's expertise lies in full-stack development, integrating robust backend solutions with dynamic front-end interfaces. Her technical acumen is grounded in Java, Spring Boot, and Angular, with a strong proficiency in Python for backend services. She specializes in crafting applications that meet meticulous standards for health institutions and banking systems in the United States and Chile.

Maria has collaborated closely with cross-functional teams and developed and maintained complex web and mobile applications that enhance user experience and fulfil client requirements. Maria's role extends beyond development to encompass support and continuous integration workflows, leveraging tools like Git, Jenkins, and AWS services to ensure seamless deployment and operational excellence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Backend developer at Qure4u of a platform deployed in health institutions in the
United States, working with Java, Spring Boot and PHP technologies.
- Full-stack engineering role in a banking institution (Scotiabank Chile) working with Java, Spring Boot, Python in backend and React in frontend.
- Developed and supported web and mobile applications in a banking institution (Chile's Bank)
working with AngularJS, Ionic and Java, delivering technological products that satisfy client's
requirements.
- Worked with CI/CD tools.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Java · Spring Boot · Angular · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Provincia de Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile
positions.description:
- Full Stack Developer working with Java and Spring boot in the backend and Angular in frontend.
- RPA Developer using UiPath for the Chilean Ministry of Transportation
- Support to systems in production using Spring, WebSphere and AngularJS.
- Orchestration of Continuous Integration flows (Git, Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus).
- Knowledge of AWS services (EC2, RDS, Elastic Beanstalk)
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Spring Boot · Angular · Git · Robotic Process Automation (RPA) · Node.js · AngularJS · UiPath

positions.title: Head of Integrations
positions.description:
- Specialized on RESTful APIs integration through Cenit platform.
- Development of solutions using Ruby language to integrate RESTful APIs mainly related with electronic commerce (Shipstation, Shopify, Lazada, Magento) to help client’s needs. It was worked with companies from United States, Singapore and Peru.
- Development and customizing Odoo modules according to client requirements. Experience with Sales, Purchases, Accounting and Inventory modules using Python.
positions.insights: Skills: SOAP · JavaScript · Odoo · NoSQL · Python · Git · Ruby

positions.title: Specialist in Computer Sciences
positions.description:
- ABAP IV developer specialized in MM module on SAP.
- Analysis and implementation of business intelligence solutions to satisfy the enterprise's needs using SAP Business Intelligence/ Business Datawarehouse.
- Web system development for Human Resources to evaluate workers performance using Python, Django, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and PostgreSQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · SAP BW · Django · SAP MM

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: - Identification Web systems development to manage personal documents such as passports, identification cards and visas using Java, ADF Framework and Oracle.
